scope: The ROM contains 73 fish-profile IDs. Sprite assets are extracted directly from the original Japanese ROM for the 72 profiles with a decoded species name; profile 0x43 remains unassigned because its ROM name glyph is unresolved.
imageNote: Each image is the first native 128x64 sprite frame decoded from the original Japanese ROM's per-profile graphics, using its normal 16-color BGR555 palette. These are sprite extractions, not screenshots or exact reproductions of the fish-record page.

graphicsTable.rowFormat: 24-bit first-animation pointer, padding byte, 24-bit second-animation pointer, padding byte
graphicsTable.pointerUse: The second pointer starts a separate animation stream and exactly bounds the first stream in all 72 named profiles.

decompression.format: 16-bit little-endian decoded size, then LSB-first literal/back-reference flags
decompression.backReference: length=(second byte & 0x0F)+3; 12-bit rolling-window reference; overlapping copy
decompression.zeroDistance: not observed in the 72 named profiles; rejected by the extractor

frame.orientation: native ROM sprite orientation; no horizontal flip

normalPalette.format: 16 BGR555 colors; color index 0 is transparent
normalPalette.conditionalVariant: The ROM has a second 16-color half used only by a conditional branch. The exact selector semantics are unresolved; catalogue assets use the first 16-color normal palette.
